sponsoring_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC), MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC individuals, partnership firms, cooperative societies for income-generating projects
description: Provides concessional term loans for viable income-generating projects such as small businesses, manufacturing units, transport vehicles, dairy, agriculture, and service enterprises.
benefits: Up to 90% of project cost financed. Interest: 6% (up to ₹5L), 8% (₹5-10L), 9% (₹10-50L). Women get 0.5% rebate.
application_process: Apply through your State Channelizing Agency (SCA) or authorized Channel Partner bank. NSFDC does not accept direct applications.

sponsoring_agency: NSFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC individuals for small/micro daily income-generating activities
description: Designed for small and micro business activities such as vegetable vending, tea stalls, tailoring, cycle repair, and other petty trades requiring minimal capital.
benefits: Up to 90% financing (max ₹1.25 Lakh). Interest rate: 6.5% p.a. Women get 0.5% rebate. Quick disbursement.
application_process: Apply through SCA, NBFC-MFI, or authorized microfinance channel partner in your state.

sponsoring_agency: NSFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC individuals for small/micro enterprises through cooperative and small finance banks
description: Supports small and micro enterprise ventures through cooperative banks and small finance banks. Ideal for individuals looking to start or expand a small business.
benefits: Up to 90% financing (max ₹4.50 Lakh) for projects up to ₹5 Lakh. Interest: 13% (Co-op banks) / 15% (SFBs).
application_process: Apply through cooperative banks or small finance banks authorized as NSFDC channel partners.

sponsoring_agency: NSFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC individuals for climate-friendly and green business activities
description: Supports environmentally sustainable business ventures such as E-rickshaws, solar energy gadgets, poly-houses, organic farming inputs, and waste recycling units.
benefits: Up to 90% financing for projects up to ₹30 Lakh. Interest: 4% (up to ₹7.5L), 6% (₹7.5-15L), 7% (₹15-30L). Lowest rates among NSFDC schemes.
application_process: Apply through SCA or authorized channel partner. Green business plan must demonstrate environmental benefit.

sponsoring_agency: NSFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC women entrepreneurs for micro-finance activities
description: A micro-finance scheme exclusively for SC women to start or expand small income-generating activities like tailoring, beauty parlours, food processing, and small retail shops.
benefits: Up to 90% financing (max ₹1.25 Lakh). Concessional interest at 6% p.a. (additional 0.5% women rebate applied).
application_process: Apply through SCA or NBFC-MFI channel partner. Only women applicants eligible.

sponsoring_agency: NSFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC individuals for small business and micro-enterprise activities
description: Supports small business ventures with project costs up to ₹5 Lakh. Ideal for starting grocery stores, mobile repair shops, auto spare parts, and small manufacturing units.
benefits: Up to 90% of project cost (max ₹4.50 Lakh). Concessional interest rates. Women get 0.5% rebate.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency or authorized channel partner.

sponsoring_agency: NSFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC students pursuing professional/technical courses in India or abroad
description: Provides concessional educational loans for SC students admitted to recognized professional and technical courses (Engineering, Medical, MBA, Law, CA, etc.) in India and abroad.
benefits: Up to 90% of course fee (max ₹40 Lakh). Interest: 6% (India), 7% (Abroad). Women get 0.5% rebate. Covers tuition, hostel, books, travel.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Students in non-professional or part-time courses

application_process: Apply through SCA with admission letter and fee structure. Course must be full-time professional/technical.

sponsoring_agency: NSFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: Single SC women (widows, divorcees, single mothers) aged 25-50
description: Economic empowerment scheme specifically for single SC women — widows, divorcees, and single mothers — to help them achieve financial independence through self-employment.
benefits: Concessional loans for small enterprises. Special priority processing. Women-only interest rebate of 0.5%.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Male applicants, married women with spouse

application_process: Apply through SCA. Must provide documentary proof of single status (widowhood/divorce).

sponsoring_agency: NSFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC artisans possessing Artisan Identity Card
description: Specifically designed for SC artisans and craftspersons to support traditional crafts, handloom, pottery, metalwork, woodwork, and other artisanal trades.
benefits: Concessional loans for craft-based enterprises. Supports raw material purchase, tools, and workshop setup.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Non-artisans, those without Artisan Identity Card

application_process: Apply through SCA with valid Artisan Identity Card.

sponsoring_agency: NSFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC women in agriculture and allied sectors
description: Designed for SC women engaged in agriculture, dairy, poultry, fisheries, and allied agricultural activities to help them scale up their farming enterprises.
benefits: Concessional loans for agri-based enterprises. Women-only interest rebate. Supports equipment and input costs.
application_process: Apply through SCA. Only SC women in agri/allied activities are eligible.

scheme_name: Credit Enhancement Guarantee Scheme for Scheduled Castes
sponsoring_agency: IFCI Limited (Nodal Agency), MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC entrepreneurs with >51% shareholding in registered companies, societies, or firms
description: Promotes entrepreneurship among SCs by providing credit guarantee to banks lending to SC entrepreneurs. Covers loans from ₹15 Lakh to ₹5 Crore for manufacturing, services, and trading.
benefits: Credit guarantee cover for loans ₹15L to ₹5 Crore. No collateral required from entrepreneur. Enables access to mainstream bank credit.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: SC shareholding must be >51%, existing defaulters

application_process: Apply through Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) listed on ifcicegssc.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: National Scheduled Tribes Finance and Development Corporation (NSTFDC), Ministry of Tribal Affairs
target_beneficiaries: ST individuals for income-generating ventures in industrial, agricultural, and service sectors
description: Provides concessional term loans for viable income-generating projects for Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs including agriculture, small business, transport, and manufacturing.
benefits: Up to 90% of project cost. Interest: 6% (up to ₹5L), 8% (up to ₹10L), 10% (above ₹10L). Max ₹50 Lakh.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency (SCA) for tribal welfare in your state.

sponsoring_agency: NSTFDC, Ministry of Tribal Affairs
target_beneficiaries: ST women for income-generating activities
description: Exclusive scheme for Scheduled Tribe women to support self-employment and micro-enterprises with highly concessional interest rates.
benefits: Loans up to ₹2 Lakh at just 4% interest. Exclusively for ST women entrepreneurs.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency for tribal welfare.

sponsoring_agency: NSTFDC, Ministry of Tribal Affairs
target_beneficiaries: ST students pursuing professional/technical courses
description: Educational loan for Scheduled Tribe students admitted to professional and technical courses at recognized institutions in India.
benefits: Up to ₹10 Lakh at 6% interest for professional courses. Covers tuition, books, hostel.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency with admission proof.

scheme_name: NBCFDC General Loan Scheme for OBC
sponsoring_agency: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC), MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: OBC individuals for self-employment and income-generating activities
description: Provides concessional loans to Other Backward Classes entrepreneurs for viable business projects in agriculture, small business, artisan trades, transport, and service sectors.
benefits: Up to 85% financing (max ₹15 Lakh). Interest: 6% (up to ₹5L), 7% (₹5-10L), 8% (₹10-15L).
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency or authorized channel partner bank.

sponsoring_agency: National Minorities Development & Finance Corporation (NMDFC), Ministry of Minority Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Minority community individuals (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Parsi, Jain) for self-employment
description: Concessional term loans for minority entrepreneurs for commercially viable projects. Two credit lines based on income levels.
benefits: Credit Line 1: Up to ₹20L at 6% (income <₹3L). Credit Line 2: Up to ₹30L at 8% (income <₹8L). Women get 2% rebate.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency or designated bank.

sponsoring_agency: NMDFC, Ministry of Minority Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Minority students pursuing professional/technical courses
description: Highly concessional educational loans for minority community students admitted to professional and technical courses.
benefits: Up to ₹20 Lakh at just 3% interest. Covers tuition, books, hostel, equipment.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency with admission letter.

sponsoring_agency: National Divyangjan Finance & Development Corporation (NDFDC), Dept of Empowerment of PwD
target_beneficiaries: Persons with Disabilities (40%+ disability) for income-generating activities
description: Concessional loans for persons with disabilities to start or expand self-employment ventures. Covers all types of disabilities recognized under PwD Act.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency or designated bank. UDID registration mandatory.

sponsoring_agency: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC), MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: Safai Karamcharis, manual scavengers, and their dependents
description: Concessional loans for safai karamcharis and their dependents for income-generating activities to help them transition to dignified livelihoods.
benefits: Loans up to ₹15 Lakh at 6-8% interest. No income ceiling. Supports sanitation-related and other businesses.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency or designated partner.

sponsoring_agency: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs for greenfield (new) enterprises
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore per bank branch for SC/ST and Women borrowers setting up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading.
benefits: Composite loans ₹10L to ₹1 Crore. Repayment up to 7 years. Moratorium up to 18 months. At every bank branch.
application_process: Apply through standupmitra.in portal, any bank branch, or Lead District Manager.

sponsoring_agency: MUDRA Ltd, Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: All Indian citizens for non-farm micro/small enterprise activities
description: Collateral-free institutional credit for micro and small enterprises. Three tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50K), Kishore (₹50K-5L), Tarun (₹5L-10L), Tarun Plus (up to ₹20L).
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹20 Lakh. No processing fee for Shishu. Covered under CGFMU guarantee.
application_process: Apply through any Commercial Bank, RRB, Small Finance Bank, MFI, or via JanSamarth portal.

sponsoring_agency: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Street vendors in urban areas for working capital
description: Micro-credit facility for street vendors to resume and expand their livelihoods. Progressive lending: ₹10K first loan, ₹20K second, ₹50K third upon timely repayment.
benefits: ₹10K-₹50K working capital. 7% interest subsidy. Digital payment incentive of ₹1200/year. No collateral.
documents_required: Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
application_process: Apply through pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through lending institutions.

sponsoring_agency: Khadi & Village Industries Commission (KVIC), Ministry of MSME
target_beneficiaries: All individuals above 18 years for new micro-enterprises in non-farm sector
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for generating self-employment by establishing new micro-enterprises. Higher subsidy for SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities/PwD.
benefits: Subsidy: 25% (urban) / 35% (rural) for General. 35% (urban) / 45% (rural) for SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities/PwD. Max project ₹50L (mfg) / ₹20L (service).

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Existing units, projects under other govt subsidy, farm activities

application_process: Apply online at kviconline.gov.in. Applications routed through KVIC/KVIB/DIC to banks.

scheme_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes
sponsoring_agency: IFCI Ltd, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC entrepreneurs with innovative/growth-oriented businesses
description: Provides venture capital to SC entrepreneurs for scaling innovative businesses. Equity/quasi-equity up to ₹15 Crore.
benefits: Venture funding up to ₹15 Crore. Equity/quasi-equity support for scaling businesses.
application_process: Apply through vcfsc.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: MoSJE under VCF-SC
target_beneficiaries: SC youth with innovative startup ideas from TBIs and hackathons
description: Provides equity assistance up to ₹30 Lakh over 3 years to SC innovators to convert ideas into commercial ventures. Successful ventures can access up to ₹15 Cr from VCF-SC.
benefits: Up to ₹30 Lakh equity over 3 years. Mentoring and incubation support. Path to ₹15 Cr venture funding.
application_process: Apply through Technology Business Incubators or hackathon winners pathway.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for MSEs
sponsoring_agency: SIDBI & Ministry of MSME
target_beneficiaries: All MSEs; higher coverage for SC/ST/Women/Micro enterprises
description: Collateral-free credit guarantee for micro and small enterprises up to ₹10 Crore. Women get 90% guarantee, SC/ST get 85%.
benefits: Collateral-free loans up to ₹10 Crore. 90% guarantee for women, 85% for SC/ST, 75% general.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Large enterprises, SHGs in some cases

application_process: Apply through any Member Lending Institution (bank). Cannot apply directly to CGTMSE.

scheme_name: Special Credit Linked Capital Subsidy for SC/ST
sponsoring_agency: National SC-ST Hub, Ministry of MSME
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST MSME entrepreneurs for technology upgradation
description: 25% capital subsidy (max ₹25 Lakh) for SC/ST entrepreneurs to procure plant and machinery for technology upgradation.
benefits: 25% subsidy up to ₹25 Lakh on plant & machinery. Supports technology upgradation.
application_process: Apply through bank when taking term loan for technology upgradation.

sponsoring_agency: Ministry of MSME
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST MSMEs seeking public procurement and market access
description: Provides professional support to SC/ST entrepreneurs to fulfil public procurement obligations. Includes vendor development, capacity building, and market linkage.
benefits: Access to government procurement opportunities. Vendor development programs. Mentoring and handholding.
application_process: Register at nssh.gov.in portal.

scheme_name: New Swarnima Scheme for OBC Women
sponsoring_agency: NBCFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: OBC women entrepreneurs for self-employment
description: Term loan scheme for OBC women to foster self-reliance through small business ventures at highly concessional 5% interest.
benefits: Up to ₹2 Lakh at just 5% interest. 95% NBCFDC funding. Only 5% own contribution.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency.

scheme_name: NBCFDC Mahila Samridhi Yojana for OBC
sponsoring_agency: NBCFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: OBC women through SHGs for micro-credit
description: Micro-credit for OBC women entrepreneurs through SHGs. Up to ₹1.25 Lakh per beneficiary at just 4% interest.
benefits: Up to ₹1.25 Lakh at 4% interest. Up to ₹15 Lakh per SHG. Quick disbursement.
application_process: Apply through SHG via State Channelizing Agency.

sponsoring_agency: NBCFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: OBC students pursuing professional/technical courses
description: Concessional education loans for OBC students. Up to ₹15 Lakh (India) / ₹20 Lakh (abroad) at 4% interest. Girls get 3.5%.
benefits: Up to ₹20 Lakh at 4% (3.5% for girls). Repayment up to 15 years with 5-year moratorium.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency with admission letter.

sponsoring_agency: NSKFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: Safai Karamcharis for sanitation-related businesses
description: Loans for sanitation vehicles, equipment, and community toilet construction. Supports mechanized sanitation under Swachh Bharat.
benefits: Up to ₹15L (individuals) / ₹50L (projects) at 4-6% interest. Supports Swachh Bharat.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency.

sponsoring_agency: NSKFDC, MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: Women safai karamcharis for micro-credit
description: Micro-credit for women safai karamcharis at highly concessional 4% interest for self-employment.
benefits: Micro-credit at 4% interest. Quick disbursement. No collateral.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency.

sponsoring_agency: MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: SC population in SC-dominated villages for holistic development
description: Comprehensive scheme for socio-economic upliftment of SC population. Covers skill development, income generation, infrastructure in SC-majority villages.
benefits: 100% Central funding. Skill training, income generation support, infrastructure development.
application_process: Implemented through state governments. Contact District Magistrate office.

sponsoring_agency: NMDFC, Ministry of Minority Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Minority women through SHGs for micro-credit
description: Micro-credit for minority women through SHGs. Up to ₹1.5 Lakh per member. 7-10% interest with women concessions.
benefits: Up to ₹1.5 Lakh per member through SHG. Concessions for women.
application_process: Apply through SHG via State Channelizing Agency.

sponsoring_agency: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce & Industry
target_beneficiaries: Early-stage startups for proof of concept and prototype
description: Financial assistance for early-stage startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, and market entry. Up to ₹50 Lakh.
benefits: Up to ₹20 Lakh (grant) for validation. Up to ₹50 Lakh (debt/convertible) for market entry.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Startups older than 2 years, non-DPIIT recognized

application_process: Apply through seedfund.startupindia.gov.in via DPIIT-recognized incubators.

sponsoring_agency: State Women Development Corporations
target_beneficiaries: Women entrepreneurs for micro-enterprises
description: State scheme providing 50% subsidy (SC/ST) / 30% subsidy (General) on loans up to ₹3 Lakh for women starting micro-enterprises.
benefits: 50% subsidy for SC/ST women, 30% for others. Loans up to ₹3 Lakh.
application_process: Apply through State Women Development Corporation or District Industries Centre.

sponsoring_agency: Department of Industries, Govt of Bihar
target_beneficiaries: Women entrepreneurs in Bihar for new enterprises
description: Up to ₹10 Lakh financial assistance for women in Bihar to set up businesses. Includes subsidy and loan components.
benefits: Up to ₹10 Lakh. Significant subsidy component. Training and handholding support.
application_process: Apply online through Bihar Industries Department portal.

sponsoring_agency: Department of Industries, Govt of Bihar
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST youth in Bihar for entrepreneurship
description: Financial assistance up to ₹10 Lakh for SC/ST youth in Bihar to promote entrepreneurship with subsidy and interest-free loan.
benefits: Up to ₹10 Lakh with 50% subsidy (₹5L) + 50% interest-free loan.
application_process: Apply online through udyami.bihar.gov.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: Dept of Industries, Govt of Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: First-generation educated entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu
description: Training, business plan assistance, and financial links for first-gen entrepreneurs. Priority for women, SC/ST, PwD. Age relaxation up to 55 years.
benefits: Up to ₹5 Lakh subsidy. 25% of project cost as margin money. Training and mentoring.
application_process: Apply through District Industries Centres in Tamil Nadu.

sponsoring_agency: Dept of MSME, Govt of Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Youth in MP for self-employment ventures
description: Financial assistance and interest subsidy for setting up new manufacturing/service enterprises in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Margin money assistance, interest subsidy, and guarantee fee reimbursement for new enterprises.
application_process: Apply through DIC or MSME portal of Madhya Pradesh.

sponsoring_agency: Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD)
description: DAY-NRLM sub-scheme helping rural poor set up local enterprises through community enterprise support.
benefits: Community Enterprise Fund (CEF) loan (avg. ₹27k, up to ₹45k), business management training, and mentoring by CRP-EPs.
target_beneficiaries: Rural Poor, SHG Members, Women (min 60% quota), SC/ST/OBC/Minority (covers ~86% of beneficiaries), PwD
application_process: Apply through local SHG / NRLM network.

scheme_name: Science Technology and Innovation Hubs for SC/ST Communities
sponsoring_agency: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
description: STI Hubs support local institutions in using science, technology, and innovation to improve livelihoods of SC and ST communities.
benefits: Livelihood improvement through Science and Technological intervention, conservation of Indigenous Knowledge Systems.
target_beneficiaries: SC and ST Communities
application_process: Through supported institutions and DST guidelines.

sponsoring_agency: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
description: Supports institutions in underserved regions to set up incubators so local innovators and startups can get space and funding.
benefits: Creates a culture of innovation and provides incubation support in nascent startup ecosystems.
target_beneficiaries: Innovators from Underserved Regions
application_process: Through supported institutions.

sponsoring_agency: MUDRA / Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: Non-corporate, non-farm small/micro-enterprises and micro units
description: Provides collateral-free loans up to ₹20 Lakh across three categories: Shishu (up to ₹50k), Kishore (₹50k-₹5L), Tarun (₹5L-₹10L/20L).
benefits: No collateral required. Low processing fee. Covers working capital and machinery loans.
application_process: Apply via JanSamarth Portal (jansamarth.in) or any Commercial Bank, RRB, or MFI.

sponsoring_agency: SIDBI / Ministry of Finance
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield enterprises
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch.
benefits: Loans from ₹10L to ₹1 Crore for manufacturing, services, trading, or agriculture-allied activities. Margin money up to 15%.
application_process: Apply online at standupmitra.in or directly at any Scheduled Commercial Bank branch.

sponsoring_agency: Ministry of MSME / MoSJE
target_beneficiaries: Traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 trades (carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, etc.)
description: Comprehensive support for traditional artisans providing skill training, toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and collateral-free enterprise loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest.
benefits: ₹15,000 Toolkit E-Voucher + ₹1 Lakh (Tranche 1) & ₹2 Lakh (Tranche 2) loan at 5% interest rate. ₹500/day stipend during training.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Government employees and their family members

application_process: Register via CSC (Common Service Centre) or pmvishwakarma.gov.in portal. Verification by Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body.

scheme_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PM-FME)
sponsoring_agency: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
target_beneficiaries: Micro food processing individual entrepreneurs, SHGs, FPOs, Cooperatives
description: Financial, technical and business support for micro food processing units adopting 'One District One Product' (ODOP) approach.
benefits: Credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of eligible project cost with maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakh per unit.
application_process: Apply online at pmfme.mofpi.gov.in or through Resource Persons (RPs) appointed by State Nodal Agencies.

sponsoring_agency: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar
target_beneficiaries: SC, ST, EBC, Women, and Youth entrepreneurs in Bihar setting up new manufacturing or service units
description: Flagship Bihar state scheme providing ₹10 Lakh financial assistance (50% grant + 50% interest-free/1% loan) for setting up micro-enterprises.
benefits: ₹5 Lakh Grant/Subsidy + ₹5 Lakh Loan (0% interest for Women/SC/ST/EBC, 1% for General Youth). Repayable in 84 installments.
application_process: Apply online at udyami.bihar.gov.in during official application window.

sponsoring_agency: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed educated youth of Uttar Pradesh for setting up industrial or service enterprises
description: Provides financial credit support up to ₹25 Lakh for Industry sector and ₹10 Lakh for Service sector with 25% state margin money subsidy.
benefits: 25% Government Margin Money Subsidy (Max ₹6.25L for Industry, ₹2.5L for Service).

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Defaulters of any bank, non-residents of UP

application_process: Apply via DIUP Portal (diupmsme.upsdc.gov.in) or DIC office.

scheme_name: One District One Product (ODOP) Margin Money Scheme (UP)
sponsoring_agency: Department of MSME, Govt of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Artisans and entrepreneurs setting up units for specified ODOP products in UP districts
description: Financial assistance scheme providing up to 20%-25% financial margin money subsidy for starting or expanding ODOP-notified traditional craft and manufacturing units.
benefits: Margin money subsidy of 25% (up to ₹6.25L for ₹25L unit), 20% (up to ₹12L for ₹60L unit), or 15% (up to ₹20L for >₹60L unit).
application_process: Apply online at odopup.in or submit through local District Industries Centre.

scheme_name: Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP Maharashtra)
sponsoring_agency: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth and entrepreneurs in Maharashtra for new micro/small projects
description: State credit-linked subsidy scheme offering up to 35% capital subsidy for manufacturing (up to ₹50 Lakh) and service (up to ₹10 Lakh) projects.
benefits: Subsidy: 15%-25% for Urban/General, 25%-35% for Rural & SC/ST/Women/PwD/Ex-servicemen. Max loan ₹50L (Mfg) / ₹10L (Service).

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Non-residents of Maharashtra, existing CMEGP/PMEGP beneficiaries

application_process: Apply via maha-cmegp.gov.in online portal.

scheme_name: New Entrepreneur cum Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS - Tamil Nadu)
sponsoring_agency: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: Educated first-generation entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu with degree/diploma/ITI qualifications
description: Financial assistance scheme providing 25% capital subsidy (max ₹75 Lakh) and 3% interest subvention for projects up to ₹5 Crore.
benefits: 25% Capital Subsidy (capped at ₹75 Lakh) + 3% Interest Subvention for the entire loan tenure.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Partnership without degree holders, pure retail trading

application_process: Apply at msmeonline.tn.gov.in or directly through District Industries Centre (DIC) in Tamil Nadu.

scheme_name: Annal Ambedkar Business Champions Scheme (AABCS - Tamil Nadu)
sponsoring_agency: MSME Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: SC and ST entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu for setting up new ventures or expanding existing units
description: Special incentive scheme for SC/ST entrepreneurs offering 35% capital subsidy (max ₹1.5 Crore) and 6% interest subvention.
benefits: 35% Capital Subsidy up to ₹1.5 Crore + 6% Interest Subvention for term loans.
application_process: Apply online at msmeonline.tn.gov.in (AABCS portal).

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Self Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP Karnataka)
sponsoring_agency: Department of Commerce and Industries, Government of Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Rural and urban entrepreneurs in Karnataka setting up micro-enterprises
description: Provides financial subsidy between 25% and 35% for projects up to ₹20 Lakh (Manufacturing) and ₹10 Lakh (Service).
benefits: Subsidy: 25% for Urban General, 35% for SC/ST/OBC/Minorities/Women/Rural. Loan up to ₹20 Lakh.
application_process: Apply via cmegp.kar.nic.in portal or Joint Director DIC office.

sponsoring_agency: Karnataka State Women's Development Corporation (KSWDC)
target_beneficiaries: Women entrepreneurs in Karnataka starting small business activities
description: Encourages women to take up self-employment in micro-trades with up to 30%-50% loan subsidy.
benefits: Subsidy: 50% for SC/ST women (max ₹1.5L subsidy on ₹3L loan). 30% for Special/General category women (max ₹90k subsidy).
application_process: Apply through KSWDC Child Development Project Officer (CDPO) or bank.

sponsoring_agency: Cottage and Rural Industries Department, Government of Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: Rural and urban cottage industry artisans, un-employed youth in Gujarat
description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme for self-employment in cottage industries, service, and small business sectors up to ₹8 Lakh.
benefits: Subsidy: 20%-40% (Rural SC/ST/Women get 40% max ₹1.25L). Max loan: ₹8L (Mfg), ₹3L (Service), ₹3L (Business).
application_process: Apply online at blp.gujarat.gov.in or DIC / District Cottage Officer.

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Laghu Udyog Protsahan Yojana (MLUPY Rajasthan)
sponsoring_agency: Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: Micro, small and medium enterprises in Rajasthan for new or expansion projects
description: Provides interest subsidy on bank loans up to ₹10 Crore to facilitate easy access to credit for manufacturing, service, and trade.
benefits: Interest Subvention: 8% on loans up to ₹25L, 6% on loans up to ₹5 Cr, 5% on loans up to ₹10 Cr.
application_process: Apply via SSO Rajasthan portal (sso.rajasthan.gov.in) under MLUPY service.

sponsoring_agency: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, West Bengal
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth in West Bengal for setting up manufacturing, service, or trading units
description: Financial scheme offering soft loans up to ₹2 Lakh along with government subsidy of 15% (max ₹25,000) for starting small enterprises.
benefits: Soft loan up to ₹2 Lakh with 15% State Subsidy. Low interest rate and simple bank processing.
application_process: Apply online at karmasathi.wb.gov.in or Block Development Office (BDO) / Municipality.

sponsoring_agency: Kerala State Backward Classes Development Corporation (KSBCDC)
target_beneficiaries: OBC and Minority entrepreneurs in Kerala for self-employment ventures
description: Concessional loans up to ₹15 Lakh at low interest rates (6%-8%) for backward classes and minority individuals in Kerala.
benefits: Loan up to ₹15 Lakh at 6%-8% interest. Special Mahila Samriddhi rebate of 1% for women applicants.
application_process: Apply via ksbcdc.com or visit local KSBCDC district office in Kerala.

sponsoring_agency: Department of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Madhya Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Youth of MP (18-45 years) setting up new manufacturing or service units
description: State credit scheme providing bank loans from ₹1 Lakh to ₹50 Lakh (Manufacturing) and up to ₹25 Lakh (Service) with 3% interest subsidy and bank guarantee cover.
benefits: 3% Interest Subvention for 7 years + 100% CGTMSE Credit Guarantee Fee covered by State.
application_process: Apply online at samast.mponline.gov.in or mpmsme.gov.in.

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Atmanirbhar Asom Abhijan (CMAAA - Assam)
sponsoring_agency: Government of Assam
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth in Assam for setting up self-employment micro-ventures
description: Financial assistance of ₹2 Lakh to ₹5 Lakh (50% Government Grant + 50% Interest-free Bank Loan) to promote self-reliance in Assam.
benefits: ₹1 Lakh Grant + ₹1 Lakh Interest-free loan (Category 1) OR ₹2.5L Grant + ₹2.5L Loan (Category 2 professional).
application_process: Apply via cmaaa.assam.gov.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: MSME Department, Government of Odisha
target_beneficiaries: New micro and small manufacturing units established in Odisha
description: State capital investment subsidy scheme providing 25% (up to ₹1 Crore) for general and 30% (up to ₹1.25 Crore) for SC/ST/Women/ST Zone units.
benefits: 25%-30% Capital Investment Subsidy on plant & machinery. Additional 5% for units in backward districts.
application_process: Apply via GO-SWIFT portal (goswift.odisha.gov.in).

scheme_name: TS-PRIDE (Telangana Program for Rapid Incubation of Dalit Entrepreneurs)
sponsoring_agency: Department of Industries, Government of Telangana
target_beneficiaries: SC and ST entrepreneurs setting up micro, small, and medium enterprises in Telangana
description: Comprehensive incentive scheme offering 35% capital subsidy (max ₹50 Lakh) and 33% power tariff subsidy for SC/ST entrepreneurs in Telangana.
benefits: 35% Investment Subsidy (max ₹50 Lakh) + 33% Power Subsidy + ₹1 per unit power rebate + 100% Stamp Duty reimbursement.
application_process: Apply online at ipass.telangana.gov.in portal.

scheme_name: YSR Cheyutha & AP SC Finance Corporation Loan Scheme
sponsoring_agency: AP Scheduled Castes Co-operative Finance Corporation / Govt of AP
target_beneficiaries: SC, ST, OBC, and Minority women aged 45-60 in Andhra Pradesh for enterprise creation
description: Provides financial assistance of ₹75,000 over 4 years along with tied-up bank linkage for setting up retail, grocery, and dairy businesses.
benefits: ₹18,750 per year direct financial assistance + Bank credit linkage for self-employment enterprises.
application_process: Apply via Navasakam portal or Village/Ward Secretariat in Andhra Pradesh.

scheme_name: Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development & Finance Corp Loan Scheme
sponsoring_agency: Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development and Finance Corporation
target_beneficiaries: SC individuals living below poverty line in Punjab for self-employment
description: Provides concessional loans up to ₹5 Lakh with up to ₹10,000 government subsidy for small trade, transport, and micro-enterprises.
benefits: Loan up to ₹5 Lakh at 6% interest p.a. + ₹10,000 capital subsidy.
application_process: Apply through District Manager PSCFC office in Punjab districts.

sponsoring_agency: Department of Industries, Himachal Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Himachali youth (18-45 years) setting up micro enterprises in Himachal Pradesh
description: Capital subsidy of 25%-35% on machinery investment up to ₹1 Crore along with 5% interest subvention for 3 years.
benefits: Subsidy: 25% for Male, 30% for Female, 35% for SC/ST/Divyang. 5% Interest Subvention for 3 years.
application_process: Apply online at mmsy.hp.gov.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: Mission Youth, Government of Jammu & Kashmir
target_beneficiaries: Young women (18-35 years) in J&K setting up self-employment micro-ventures
description: Financial assistance up to ₹5 Lakh to young women for starting business units with 10% state upfront subsidy and full interest subvention.
benefits: ₹50,000 upfront state subsidy + 100% Interest Subvention (0% effective interest rate).
application_process: Apply via Mission Youth J&K online portal (missionyouthjk.in).

sponsoring_agency: Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council (BIRAC), DST
target_beneficiaries: Biotech, Agritech, Medtech, and Life Sciences early-stage innovators and startups
description: Offers non-dilutive grant-in-aid up to ₹50 Lakhs to scientists, graduates, and startups to establish Proof of Concept for commercial biotech inventions.
benefits: 100% Non-dilutive grant up to ₹50 Lakhs for 18 months + Mentorship + Access to BIRAC bio-incubators.
application_process: Apply online via birac.nic.in during BIG Call windows (Jan & July).

scheme_name: NIDHI-PRAYAS (Promoting and Accelerating Young and Aspiring innovators)
sponsoring_agency: Department of Science and Technology (DST)
target_beneficiaries: Individual tech innovators and early hardware startups building physical prototypes
description: Provides financial grant up to ₹10 Lakhs to translate innovative hardware and deeptech ideas into proof-of-concept functional prototypes.
benefits: Up to ₹10 Lakhs prototype grant + Lab access at PRAYAS Centres (DST Incubators).

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Pure software or IT services without hardware innovation

application_process: Apply directly through DST PRAYAS incubators across India.

scheme_name: National EWS & General Category Enterprise Support Scheme
sponsoring_agency: Ministry of MSME / State DICs
target_beneficiaries: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and General Category entrepreneurs setting up micro-enterprises
description: Concessional credit and 15%-25% capital margin money subsidy for General and EWS category individuals starting manufacturing, service, or retail ventures.
benefits: 15% to 25% Capital Subsidy + Credit Guarantee under CGTMSE. Loans up to ₹50 Lakhs with bank credit linkage.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Income tax payers with family income > ₹8 Lakhs

application_process: Apply via JanSamarth portal or DIC in your district.

scheme_name: NMDFDC Term Loan Scheme for Minorities
sponsoring_agency: National Minorities Development & Finance Corporation (NMDFDC), Ministry of Minority Affairs
target_beneficiaries: Individuals from notified Minority Communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) for self-employment
description: Concessional loans up to ₹30 Lakhs for manufacturing, commercial transport, service, and agricultural businesses for minority entrepreneurs.
benefits: Loans up to ₹30 Lakhs at 6% to 8% interest rate. Credit up to 90% of project cost.
application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agency (SCA) for Minority Development.

scheme_name: iStart Rajasthan Startup Policy & Seed Grant
sponsoring_agency: Department of Information Technology & Communication, Rajasthan
target_beneficiaries: Innovative startups registered in Rajasthan across Ideation, Seed, and Growth stages
description: Offers up to ₹2.4 Lakhs Ideation Grant, up to ₹60 Lakhs Seed Grant, and ₹10,000-₹25,000 monthly sustenance allowance for QRate ranked startups.
benefits: Ideation Grant ₹2.4L + Seed Grant up to ₹60L + Monthly Sustenance Allowance up to ₹25,000/month for 1 year.
application_process: Register and apply online via istart.rajasthan.gov.in portal.

scheme_name: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM) Idea & Seed Fund
sponsoring_agency: Kerala Startup Mission, Government of Kerala
target_beneficiaries: Early-stage innovative startups registered in Kerala
description: Provides non-dilutive Idea Grants up to ₹7 Lakhs (up to ₹12 Lakhs for Women/Transgender founders) and Seed Loans up to ₹15 Lakhs at 6% simple interest.
benefits: ₹7L - ₹12L Non-dilutive Grant + ₹15L Soft Loan at 6% interest + Co-working space & incubation.
application_process: Apply via startupmission.kerala.gov.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: Startup Odisha, MSME Department, Govt of Odisha
target_beneficiaries: DPIIT / Startup Odisha recognized innovative startups in Odisha
description: Offers ₹20,000/month sustenance allowance for 1 year (₹22,000/month for Women/SC/ST/PwD) and Product Development / Marketing grant up to ₹15 Lakhs.
benefits: ₹20,000/month Sustenance Allowance for 12 months + ₹15 Lakhs Product Development Grant.
application_process: Apply online at startupodisha.gov.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: Department of Electronics, IT, Bt and S&T, Government of Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Innovative early-stage startups registered in Karnataka
description: Flagship grant-in-aid scheme providing up to ₹50 Lakhs non-dilutive grant to early-stage startups across General, Shakti (Women), and Unnati (SC/ST) tracks.
benefits: 100% Non-dilutive Grant up to ₹50 Lakhs + Incubation support + Mentorship.
application_process: Apply during annual ELEVATE call on startup.karnataka.gov.in.

sponsoring_agency: NEDFi / Ministry of Development of North Eastern Region (DoNER)
target_beneficiaries: Startups and early-stage commercial ventures in North Eastern States (Assam, Meghalaya, Manipur, Nagaland, Mizoram, Tripura, Arunachal, Sikkim)
description: Dedicated venture capital fund offering equity and quasi-equity investment from ₹25 Lakhs to ₹1 Crore for innovative North Eastern enterprises.
benefits: Venture equity capital investment up to ₹1 Crore + Incubation & market linkage across NE region.
application_process: Apply via nedfi.com/nevf portal.

sponsoring_agency: Dept of Industries, Govt of Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Educated unemployed youth in Chhattisgarh
description: Credit-linked subsidy for manufacturing (up to ₹25L), service (up to ₹10L), and business (up to ₹2L) projects with interest subsidy and CGTMSE cover.
benefits: Govt covers CGTMSE guarantee fee + interest subsidy. Extra 10% grant for SC/ST/Women/PwD.
application_process: Apply via DIC or invest.cg.gov.in portal.

scheme_name: Chhattisgarh Startup Seed Fund & Interest Subsidy
sponsoring_agency: Dept of IT, Govt of Chhattisgarh
target_beneficiaries: Recognized startups in Chhattisgarh for PoC and MVP development
description: Up to ₹10L seed funding for PoC/MVP + up to 75% interest subsidy (max ₹50L) for 5 years on term/working capital loans + ₹50 Cr credit risk fund for collateral-free loans up to ₹1 Cr.
benefits: ₹10L Seed Fund + 75% Interest Subsidy (max ₹50L for 5 yrs) + Stamp duty exemption. Extra 10% for SC/ST/Women/PwD.
application_process: Apply via Chhattisgarh Startup Portal.

sponsoring_agency: SC/ST/OBC Development Dept, Govt of Jharkhand
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed SC/ST/BC/Minority/PwD youth in Jharkhand
description: Subsidized loans up to ₹25L with 40% state subsidy on loan amount. No margin money for loans up to ₹50,000.
benefits: 40% State Government Subsidy on loan. 10% beneficiary margin for loans > ₹50K. Zero margin for loans ≤ ₹50K.
application_process: Apply via Sankalp Portal or JSTCDC/JSMFDC district office.

scheme_name: Startup Haryana Seed Grant & Lease Subsidy
sponsoring_agency: Startup Haryana, Dept of IT, Govt of Haryana
target_beneficiaries: DPIIT-recognized startups with Haryana address
description: Seed grants up to ₹10L + 30% lease rental reimbursement (45% for women-led, max ₹5L for 1 yr) + 100% patent filing reimbursement (up to ₹25L).
benefits: ₹10L Seed Grant + 30-45% Lease Rental Subsidy + Patent Reimbursement up to ₹25L.
application_process: Register on startupharyana.gov.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: Haryana Women Development Corporation (HWDC)
target_beneficiaries: Women entrepreneurs in Haryana with family income < ₹5L
description: 7% interest subvention for 3 years on loans up to ₹5 Lakh for women entrepreneurs from low-income families.
benefits: 7% Interest Subvention for 3 years on loans up to ₹5L.
application_process: Apply via Saral Haryana portal or HWDC office.

sponsoring_agency: Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation (HSFDC)
target_beneficiaries: SC and BC individuals in Haryana for micro and small enterprises
description: Low-cost credit from ₹15,000 to ₹3 Lakh at 2% annual interest rate for self-employment ventures.
benefits: Loan ₹15K to ₹3L at 2% p.a. interest rate.
application_process: Apply via Saral Haryana portal or HSFDC district office.

sponsoring_agency: Dept of Industries, Govt of Uttarakhand
target_beneficiaries: Unemployed youth in Uttarakhand for manufacturing, service, or business ventures
description: Bank-linked loan scheme with 25%-40% state subsidy depending on district category and social category.
benefits: Subsidy: 25% General, 30% Women, 35% SC/ST, 40% for backward hill districts.
application_process: Apply via DIC office or msy.uk.gov.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: Women Empowerment & Child Development Dept, Uttarakhand
target_beneficiaries: Single, widowed, abandoned, divorced women, acid attack survivors, and transgender persons in Uttarakhand
description: Project assistance up to ₹2 Lakh with 75% government subsidy for establishing micro-enterprises.
benefits: 75% Government Subsidy (max ₹1.5L) on project cost up to ₹2L.
application_process: Apply via District Women Welfare Office.

scheme_name: Goa Startup Policy Seed Grant & Incentives
sponsoring_agency: Startup IT Promotion Cell (SITPC), Govt of Goa
target_beneficiaries: Innovative startups registered in Goa
description: Seed capital grants up to ₹10L + Venture Capital Fund of Funds (up to ₹1 Cr equity) + 50% R&D reimbursement (up to ₹5L/yr) + salary reimbursement + lease rental support.
benefits: ₹10L Seed Grant + ₹1 Cr Equity via Fund of Funds + 50% R&D Reimbursement + Salary Support.
application_process: Apply via Goa Startup Portal or SITPC office.

sponsoring_agency: Directorate of Industries, Trade & Commerce, Goa
target_beneficiaries: Individuals and firms in Goa with bank loans for approved self-employment activities
description: 25% subsidy on fixed capital investment (premises, plant, machinery, furniture) for bank-linked self-employment projects.
benefits: 25% Subsidy on Fixed Capital Investment.
application_process: Apply via goaonline.gov.in or EDC Panaji office.

sponsoring_agency: Delhi SC/ST/OBC/Minorities & Handicapped Finance Corp (DSFDC)
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST/OBC/Minority and PwD individuals in Delhi for self-employment
description: Need-based loans up to ₹5 Lakh at 6% interest for income-generating self-employment activities.
benefits: Loan up to ₹5L at 6% interest p.a. Low processing charges.
application_process: Apply through DSFDC district office or dsfdc.delhi.gov.in.

sponsoring_agency: DSFDC / NBCFDC, Delhi
target_beneficiaries: Women entrepreneurs from backward classes in Delhi
description: Term loans up to ₹2 Lakh at concessional 5% p.a. interest rate for women starting small businesses. No beneficiary contribution for projects up to ₹2L.
benefits: ₹2L Loan at 5% interest. Zero beneficiary contribution.
application_process: Apply through DSFDC office.

scheme_name: TANSEED - Tamil Nadu Startup Seed Grant Fund
sponsoring_agency: StartupTN, Govt of Tamil Nadu
target_beneficiaries: DPIIT-recognized early-stage startups registered in Tamil Nadu with PoC/MVP
description: Equity-linked seed grant up to ₹15L (Green Tech/Women/Rural Impact) and up to ₹10L (other sectors) + 1-year accelerator with mentorship.
benefits: ₹10-15L Seed Grant + 1-year Accelerator Program. 3% support stake to StartupTN.

eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Subsidiaries of foreign firms, non-TN registered

application_process: Apply during TANSEED cohort calls on startuptn.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: Maharashtra State Innovation Society (MSInS)
target_beneficiaries: Early-stage entrepreneurs and startups in Maharashtra
description: Dedicated ₹500 Cr fund providing loan assistance of ₹5L-₹10L per startup. Pilot work orders up to ₹25L through Maharashtra Startup Week.
benefits: ₹5-10L Startup Loan Assistance + ₹25L Pilot Work Orders + IPR Reimbursement.
application_process: Register on msins.in portal and apply during funding calls.

scheme_name: Startup Gujarat Seed Support & Sustenance Allowance
sponsoring_agency: Dept of Science & Technology, Govt of Gujarat
target_beneficiaries: Recognized startups in Gujarat
description: ₹20K/month sustenance allowance for 1 year (₹25K/month for women co-founders) + up to ₹30L seed support for prototype, market research, testing, and marketing.
benefits: ₹20-25K/month Sustenance Allowance + ₹30L Seed Support + Incubation access.
application_process: Apply via Startup Gujarat portal.

sponsoring_agency: Dept of MSME & Textiles, Govt of West Bengal
target_beneficiaries: New micro, small and medium manufacturing enterprises in West Bengal
description: Comprehensive fiscal incentive scheme providing State Capital Investment Subsidy, interest subsidy on term loans, stamp duty & registration fee reimbursement, and quality certification subsidies for MSMEs.
benefits: Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) for Micro/Small units + Interest subsidy on term loans + Stamp duty reimbursement + ISO/BIS certification costs covered.
application_process: Apply via Shilpasathi Portal or wbmsme.gov.in.

sponsoring_agency: WB SC ST & OBC Development & Finance Corporation
target_beneficiaries: SC/ST/OBC individuals in West Bengal for self-employment ventures
description: Concessional self-employment loans with interest subvention for SC/ST/OBC entrepreneurs under the poverty line via NSFDC/NSTFDC channeling.
benefits: Concessional loans with government interest subvention. Channeled via NSFDC/NSTFDC.
application_process: Apply via WBSCSTFDC district office or wbbcdev.gov.in.

scheme_name: AP Innovation & Startup Policy 4.0 Seed Grant
sponsoring_agency: Andhra Pradesh Innovation Society (APIS)
target_beneficiaries: Early-stage innovative startups in Andhra Pradesh
description: Tiered seed funding: ₹2L for Prototype/PoC, ₹15L for MVP/Scaling, ₹20L for Women/SC/ST/BC inclusive startups. Ratan Tata Innovation Hub provides up to ₹30L incubation funding.
benefits: ₹2-20L Seed Grants + ₹30L Incubation Funding via RTIH + Mentorship.
application_process: Apply via apinnovationsociety.com or RTIH spoke centers.

sponsoring_agency: MSME Department, Govt of Andhra Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: New micro, small and medium manufacturing/service enterprises in AP
description: 25% capital subsidy for General category; enhanced 45% for Women/SC/ST/BC/Minorities/PwD. Additional 75% land cost rebate (max ₹25L) for SC/ST. 100% SGST reimbursement for 5 years.
benefits: 25-45% Capital Subsidy + 75% Land Rebate for SC/ST + 100% SGST Reimbursement + 7-10% Interest Subsidy.
application_process: Apply via apmsmeone.ap.gov.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: T-Hub Foundation, Govt of Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Early-stage tech startups in Telangana
description: Co-investment fund providing ₹25L to ₹1 Cr for product development and scaling. T-Spark seed grants for prototype building and R&D.
benefits: ₹25L-₹1 Cr Investment + Incubation + Mentorship via T-Hub + Performance grants (5% turnover up to ₹10L).
application_process: Apply via t-hub.co portal or T-Hub Hyderabad office.

sponsoring_agency: WE-Hub, Govt of Telangana
target_beneficiaries: Women entrepreneurs and women-led startups in Telangana
description: India's first state-led incubator exclusively for women. Provides mentorship, market access, government scheme navigation, and connects women founders to investors and grants.
benefits: Incubation + Mentorship + Market Access + Investor Connect + Government Scheme Navigation for Women.
application_process: Apply via we-hub.in portal.

scheme_name: Punjab Startup Seed Grant & Interest Subsidy
sponsoring_agency: Dept of Industries & Commerce, Govt of Punjab
target_beneficiaries: DPIIT-recognized startups in Punjab
description: Seed grants up to ₹5L + 25% lease rental reimbursement (max ₹3L/yr for 1 yr) + 8% interest subsidy (max ₹5L/yr for 5 yrs) on bank loans.
benefits: ₹5L Seed Grant + 25% Lease Rental Subsidy + 8% Interest Subsidy for 5 years.
application_process: Apply via invest.punjab.gov.in (Business First Portal).

scheme_name: PRIME Hub Meghalaya (Promotion & Incubation of Market-driven Enterprises)
sponsoring_agency: Meghalaya Basin Development Authority / Govt of Meghalaya
target_beneficiaries: Entrepreneurs and startups in Meghalaya across ideation to scaling stages
description: Comprehensive enterprise incubation: Ideation grants, interest-free loans, mentorship, and market linkage. Includes CM's ELEVATE program and SEED scheme for small empowerment.
benefits: Incubation + Interest-free Loans + Mentorship + Market Linkage + SEED grants.
application_process: Apply via primemeghalaya.com portal.

sponsoring_agency: Dept of IT & Communication, Govt of Nagaland
target_beneficiaries: Recognized startups in Nagaland
description: Seed grants, GST reimbursement, digital upgradation subsidies, and power subsidies for Nagaland-registered innovative startups.
benefits: Seed Grants + GST Reimbursement + Digital Upgradation Subsidy + Power Subsidy.
application_process: Apply via startup.nagaland.gov.in.

sponsoring_agency: Commerce & Industries Dept, Govt of Sikkim
target_beneficiaries: Educated unemployed youth in Sikkim setting up enterprises
description: Financial subsidy assistance for loans taken by skilled youth to establish new enterprises in manufacturing, service, and agriculture-allied sectors.
benefits: Government subsidy on bank loans + Skill training support.
application_process: Apply via District Industries Centre, Sikkim.

sponsoring_agency: Dept of IT, Govt of Tripura
target_beneficiaries: Innovative startups registered in Tripura
description: Sector-agnostic startup policy providing facilitation, seed support, and incubation for innovative products and processes. Aims to make Tripura a top startup destination by 2028.
benefits: Seed Support + Incubation + Market Linkage + Government Facilitation.
application_process: Apply via startup.tripura.gov.in portal.

sponsoring_agency: Dept of IT, Govt of Manipur
target_beneficiaries: Innovative startups registered in Manipur
description: Provides financial and operational support to turn innovative ideas into opportunities. Focuses on fostering entrepreneurial culture in Manipur.
benefits: Financial Support + Operational Assistance + Mentorship + Market Access.
application_process: Apply via Startup Manipur portal.

sponsoring_agency: Entrepreneurship Development Centre, Govt of Mizoram
target_beneficiaries: Entrepreneurs and startups in Mizoram
description: Focuses on awareness, capacity building, and outreach across districts. Provides seed support and incubation for innovative ventures.
benefits: Seed Support + Capacity Building + District Outreach + Incubation.
application_process: Apply via Entrepreneurship Development Centre, Aizawl.

sponsoring_agency: Dept of Industries, Govt of Arunachal Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Aspiring entrepreneurs and startups in Arunachal Pradesh
description: Seed funding, incubation support, and financial awards to top ventures. Recent APEDP 5.0 offered substantial grants for innovative ideas.
benefits: Seed Funding + Incubation + Financial Awards for Top Ventures + Mentorship.
application_process: Apply during APEDP cohort calls via state portal.

scheme_name: Bihar Startup Policy Seed Grant & Interest-Free Loan
sponsoring_agency: Dept of Industries, Govt of Bihar
target_beneficiaries: Recognized startups in Bihar
description: Interest-free loan of up to ₹10L for 10 years + ₹3L training grant. Additional 5% incentive for Women/SC/ST, 15% for PwD entrepreneurs.
benefits: ₹10L Interest-Free Loan for 10 yrs + ₹3L Training Grant + 5% extra for Women/SC/ST + 15% extra for PwD.
application_process: Apply via startup.bihar.gov.in portal.
